plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Topsec TOS firewalls. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, sessions/connections, session establishment rate, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 14331).
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Topsec TOS firewall since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Topsec TOS firewall (TOS-SYSSTATE cpuLoad). The device reports percent times 100, so the query divides by 100 to yield a 0-100 percent. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate inspection overload or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Topsec TOS firewall (TOS-SYSSTATE memoryLoad). The device reports percent times 100, so the query divides by 100 to yield a 0-100 percent. High memory pressure can degrade session handling.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total physical memory of the Topsec TOS firewall in bytes (TOS-SYSSTATE memoryTotal).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free physical memory of the Topsec TOS firewall in bytes (TOS-SYSSTATE memoryFree).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used physical memory of the Topsec TOS firewall in bytes, derived as memoryTotal minus memoryFree.

metrics.name: firewall_active_sessions
metrics.description: Number of current connections on the Topsec TOS firewall (TOS-SYSSTATE currentConnections). A rapid rise can indicate a connection flood or session-table pressure.

metrics.name: firewall_session_rate
metrics.description: New connections per second on the Topsec TOS firewall (TOS-SYSSTATE cps). A sudden spike can indicate a flood or a burst of new sessions.
